## Design rules

Checked against [docs/design-rules.md](../docs/design-rules.md) (PLAN.md §15). Mark N/A where a rule does not apply.

- [ ] No emoji, no filler copy, sentence case (§15.1)
- [ ] Units shown with a space before the unit (`62 bpm`) (§15.1 rule 6)
- [ ] Spacing uses the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48 scale only (§15.2)
- [ ] Page padding unchanged or uses the shared modifier/wrapper (§15.2 rule 11)
- [ ] No gradients, shadows, glows or rounded corners (§15.3)
- [ ] Colour only for meaning (§15.3 rule 18)
- [ ] Loading, stale and destructive-action states follow §15.4
- [ ] Screenshots reviewed (`screenshots` label on PRs that touch `ios/` or `web/`)
